# voipms_phonebook_entry (Resource)

Manages a phonebook entry (`setPhonebook` / `delPhonebook`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "voipms_phonebook_group" "spam" {
  name = "Spam"
}

resource "voipms_phonebook_entry" "blocked_prefix" {
  name   = "Blocked prefix"
  number = "999"
  group  = voipms_phonebook_group.spam.id
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Contact name.
- `number` (String) Phone number or prefix.

### Optional

- `callerid` (String) Caller ID name override.
- `group` (String) Phonebook group id.
- `note` (String) Note.
- `speed_dial` (String) Speed-dial code.

### Read-Only

- `group_name` (String) Group name (read-only).
- `id` (String) VoIP.ms phonebook entry id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import voipms_phonebook_entry.blocked_prefix 476494
```
